representations.name: full sparse transverse expansion
representations.new_information: retains all eight independent edge activities and every mixed u,v,q term erased by orbit equalization
representations.first_test: independently enumerate forests and hash the complete sparse coefficient ledger

representations.name: simultaneous-involution invariant ring
representations.new_information: records that only total transverse parity is even and separates genuine invariants from falsely assumed independent pair symmetries
representations.first_test: list the exact transverse monomial support and exhibit the first mixed odd-in-one-coordinate terms

representations.name: quadratic q-fibre wall pair
representations.new_information: keeps the two q-quadratics P and xi over the u,v base with their leading signs, discriminants, and resultant
representations.first_test: compute Res_q(P,xi) and classify the anchor base chamber

representations.name: projective transverse ray root order
representations.new_information: turns every anchor ray into one cubic and one quadratic in s=t^2 and preserves first-wall order
representations.first_test: isolate the first positive P and xi roots for exact rational direction triples

representations.name: symmetric polarization comparator plus correction
representations.new_information: separates the Garding-preserved independent symmetric polarization of the fixed polynomial from graph-specific mixed corrections
representations.first_test: compute the exact difference between the full polynomial and the three-pair polarization

representations.name: full derivative-component chamber
representations.new_information: uses positivity of every nonzero edge-level partial derivative on the full distinguished component rather than only fixed-orbit derivatives
representations.first_test: factor the smallest mixed derivatives that constrain u,v,q

representations.name: transverse boundary SOS multiplier
representations.new_information: seeks an identity making xi nonnegative on P=0 plus a monotone inward derivative, without assuming component convexity
representations.first_test: solve low-degree exact multiplier equations on the anchor transverse fibre

representations.name: equivariant component retraction
representations.new_information: tests whether averaging a point with its involution image can be replaced by a certified P-positive path to the fixed space
representations.first_test: find a P-positive asymmetric point whose straight averaging segment crosses P=0

representations.name: exact asymmetric counterexample path
representations.new_information: keeps both an xi-negative endpoint and exact component membership through rational polygonal paths and Bernstein/Sturm certificates
representations.first_test: search rational endpoints, then reject every segment with exact root isolation

representations.name: finite transverse CAD roadmap
representations.new_information: retains all connected cells and exceptional intersections after quotienting only the true simultaneous involution
representations.first_test: measure degree and cell growth first on the positive-anchor base fibre
